description: This file defines the 'SecurityNotAllowedMethodError' exception class used in Twig's sandbox security system to handle attempts to invoke disallowed class methods within templates.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedMethodError
classes.description: An exception class thrown when a disallowed class method is used in a Twig template within the sandbox security system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message, class name, and method name related to the security error.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class involved in the security violation.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method involved in the security violation.
